5097669.name: Chabad of South County
5097669.note: Its own page ('The Reinitzes'): 'In August 2021, Rabbi Mendy and Lieba Reinitz and their daughter Mushky arrived in South Kingstown, RI to open a Chabad center for the Jewish population of Southern RI.' Its chabad.org listing went up June 2 2021, just before; therebbesimpact.com also has 2021. At 77 Main St., South Kingstown.

3697415.name: Lubavitch of Ames
3697415.note: The Greater Des Moines Jewish Press, Winter Edition (December 2017 to February 2018), 'What is Chabad-Lubavitch': 'Rabbi Leibel and Malka Jacobson have moved to Ames to establish a Chabad center' and 'the Jacobson's just moved and have barely had time to settle in'. Its chabad.org listing went up July 4 2017; L'Chaim weekly no. 1501 (Miketz 5778, Dec 2017) also reports the move. Serves Iowa State University; 414 Stanton Ave.

7117900.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Great Falls
7117900.note: Rabbi Chaim Bruk (Chabad of Montana) on X, Oct 28 2024 (the date from the post's ID; read from a search index's copy, the page itself would not load): the Great Falls shluchim Rabbi Mendel and Devorah Leah Spiero, who serve at Touro University's new medical school there, 'moved to town almost 18 months ago', so about May 2023 (counted back, medium). Touro's Great Falls campus opened in August 2023; they were inviting Great Falls to Purim in March 2024 (Congregation Aitz Chaim's newsletter); therebbesimpact.com also has 2023. Its chabad.org listing went up only on May 26 2026.
